entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Buccaneers head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that Mayfield (thumb) is expected to miss three weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Colbie Young
entries.summary: Young (knee) is not expected to play in Week 4 against the Jaguars, Jay Morrison of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Jack Bech
entries.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak confirmed Monday that Bech (forearm) is slated to be placed on injured reserve, Paul Gutierrez of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: McMillan has been diagnosed with a PCL sprain in his left knee, Jenna Laine of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: Oliver was diagnosed with a torn biceps following an MRI on Monday and is expected to undergo surgery in the coming days, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tanner McKee
entries.summary: McKee (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the team's emergency third quarterback Monday night against the Bears.

entries.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
entries.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said that Etienne will have some "time lost" due to the hamstring injury he sustained in Sunday's 35-27 loss to the Raiders, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) returning to practice next week is potentially "on the table," Corbin Smith of SI.com reports.

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: doubtful

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said Monday that he still has no update regarding how long Reed (neck) will be sidelined, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Coach Sean McVay said Monday that Ferguson "likely" will be sidelined for Sunday's game in Philadelphia, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Adonai Mitchell
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Aidan O'Connell
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Ashton Dulin
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Barion Brown
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Breece Hall
entries.summary: Hall is considered week-to-week after an MRI on Monday revealed that his thigh injury isn't significant as feared, Ian Rapoport and Adam Schefter of ESPN report.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Dolphins head coach Jeff Hafley said Douglas (ankle) is day-to-day and could practice Wednesday, Travis Wingfield of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Chig Okonkwo
entries.summary: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Okonkwo (hamstring) will make the trip to London and will practice in some capacity leading up to Sunday's game against the Colts, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Colby Parkinson
entries.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Monday that Parkinson is day-to-day due to an AC joint sprain in his shoulder that he picked up during the Rams' 30-26 loss to the Broncos on Sunday, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Hollywood Brown
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Coker has been diagnosed with a minor quadriceps strain and could be available to play in next Sunday's game against the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: Daniels will avoid a procedure on his dislocated left elbow for the time being, but Adam Schefter of ESPN reports that the quarterback could undergo surgery after the season.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that he considers Wright (stinger/foot) to be "day-to-day," Joe Schad of The Palm Beach Post reports.

entries.name: Josh Allen
entries.summary: Bills head coach Joe Brady downplayed any concern about Allen's health after the quarterback took a hit to his knee area during the fourth quarter of Sunday's 24-16 win over the Chargers, Alex Brasky of SI.com and Alec White of the team's official site report. "We're gonna have to see how [Allen] progresses these next couple days," Brady said. "Josh is always a little [sore] after the game."

entries.name: Justin Jefferson
entries.summary: Jefferson was diagnosed Monday with a sprained left ankle following an MRI, and the Vikings are hopeful that he'll be able to play Sunday versus the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Kene Nwangwu
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Mason Taylor
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Evans is considered day-to-day after sustaining a rib strain during Sunday's 36-30 win over the Cardinals, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Nico Collins
entries.summary: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that he's "hopeful" to have Collins available for the Texans' Week 4 game against the Cowboys, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Head coach Sean McVay said Monday that the Rams are "hopeful" Nacua (hip) will return to action for Sunday's game at Philadelphia, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle (toe) wasn't present for Monday's walkthrough practice, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tylan Wallace
entries.summary: Wallace (knee) did not participate in the Browns' estimated practice Monday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown was spotted Monday in the Patriots' locker room walking without a limp and wearing a small wrap on his injured right ankle, Taylor Kyles of CLNSMedia.com reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Colts head coach Shane Steichen reiterated Monday that Pierce didn't undergo surgery on his left heel and is continuing to rehab the injury, James Boyd of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: The Bengals placed Iosivas (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Arian Smith
entries.summary: Smith (knee) underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn ACL and will miss the rest of the season, Antwan V. Staley of the New York Daily News reports.

entries.name: De'Von Achane
entries.summary: The Dolphins placed Achane (knee) on injured reserve Monday.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: The 49ers placed Robinson (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Jaxson Dart
entries.summary: The Giants officially placed Dart (knee) on injured reserve Thursday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Jonah Coleman
entries.summary: Coleman (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve Saturday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks is expected to undergo surgery Wednesday to repair a core-muscle injury and is likely to miss at least six weeks, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Ronnie Rivers
entries.summary: The Rams placed Rivers (calf) on their injured reserve list Wednesday.
